funFacts: Lando Norris claimed his third Grand Prix victory of 2026, leading every lap from pole position in Singapore.
McLaren scored 40 points in a single weekend with Norris P1 and Oscar Piastri P3 to extend their Constructors' Championship lead.
The 20.945-second margin of victory was the largest recorded at the Singapore Grand Prix in the hybrid era.

headline: Singapore GP: Lando Norris converts pole into crushing 20-second victory over Verstappen
whyCareReason: Lando Norris drives an untouchable race under the Marina Bay lights, securing a dominant 20-second win to deliver McLaren massive championship points.
teaser: Sunday night at Marina Bay: Lando Norris commands all 62 laps to defeat Max Verstappen by 20.945 seconds, while Oscar Piastri finishes third for McLaren.
story:
Why this one matters: Under the blinding floodlights of Marina Bay, Lando Norris produced the most emphatic drive of his career, turning what is traditionally Formula 1's most chaotic circuit into a masterclass in domination.

From the moment the red lights extinguished, Norris controlled the launch, fended off Max Verstappen through Turn 1, and built an immediate margin. By lap 15, his lead had ballooned past 10 seconds as his McLaren MCL38 exhibited superior balance and tire preservation through the humid Singapore air. Even a brush with the barriers on lap 29 failed to slow his momentum.

Verstappen drove a lonely, disciplined race to take second, 20.945 seconds adrift. With Oscar Piastri carving through from fifth to take third, McLaren collected 40 points in a single weekend to tighten their grip on the Constructors' Championship standings.
stakes: 25 vital championship points for Norris, slashing Verstappen's points cushion and consolidating McLaren's constructors' championship supremacy.
rivalryAngle: Norris proves his pace advantage on high-downforce street circuits, applying intense psychological pressure on Red Bull.
